title: Exam Day
caption: Everything here is paraphrased from the official exam guide v1.0 (sections 11 to 14, PDF pp.33-35). Policies can change: re-read the current guide and the Pearson VUE pages before you book. Not legal or policy advice.

sections.title: Before the day
rows: Via the Anthropic Partner Academy; read the exam guide, the Certification Terms and Conditions and the Certification Exam Policy first
$125 USD; the checkout price reflects any discount for your partner tier
Create a Pearson VUE account, then pick a date and either online proctoring or a Pearson test center
Allowed up to 24 hours before the appointment; later changes forfeit the fee
Valid, unexpired, government-issued photo ID; the name must match your registration exactly
Must be approved by Pearson VUE before you schedule; do not book until approved
Forfeits the fee and you must re-register. The guide does not state the late-arrival window

sections.title: During the exam
rows: Online: stay in view of the proctor and the webcam for the whole session
Keep the workspace clear of notes, books, phones, second monitors and other materials
Never capture, copy, photograph or reproduce any exam content
Prohibited: phones, smart watches, headphones, study materials, any recording device. Permitted items, such as proctor-provided scratch paper, are set by Pearson VUE
You accept a confidentiality agreement before starting; if you decline, the session ends with no refund
Misconduct can mean an invalidated result, a revoked credential and a ban from future exams

sections.title: The exam itself
rows: 60, multiple-choice and multiple-response; each item says how many answers to select
4 scenarios drawn from a bank of 6
Pass or fail, scaled score, percent correct by domain
sections.warning: The real exam has multiple-response items. The question bank and the Timed Mock here are single-answer only, so practise reading each stem for how many answers it asks for.

sections.title: After the exam
rows: 14 days after the first fail, 30 after the second, 90 after the third
Up to four attempts in a rolling twelve months, per exam; the fee applies each time
On time: review what changed and pass a free, non-proctored assessment on the Partner Academy; lapsed: retake the full exam at the full fee
Within 14 days of being notified, or of the exam date for a result concern, through Pearson VUE support

checklist: Read the guide, Terms and Conditions and Exam Policy
Name on my ID matches my registration exactly
Booked, and I know the cancel-by time (24 hours before)
Testing space cleared; phone, watch and headphones out of reach
Passed a timed mock at or above the 720 estimate
All four readiness gates are green on the Error Log page
contacts: Contacts per the guide: name corrections to certifications-support@anthropic.com; everything else to Pearson VUE support (pearsonvue.com/us/en/anthropic.html).
